# Everything V2 uses

Generated by `v2/ecad/tools/kb/kb_inventory.py`. **Never hand edited**: edit the
generators, the BOMs, the design documents or the declaration files beside this one, and
regenerate. It is the enumerated answer to what this kit is made of, and it is checked
against the datasheet store on every run.

Three independent sources are read and must agree: **bom**, the shipped BOM of the newest
deliverable per board, which is what an assembler places; **gen**, the generators, which
is what the design instantiates; and **doc**, `V2-SPEC.md`, `ASSEMBLY.md`, `PANEL.md` and
`BUILD.md`, which carry everything never placed on a board. The design record appendix is
deliberately not read: it is the whole history, and enumerating it would enumerate the past.

| state | meaning | count |
|---|---|---|
| DOCUMENTED | a document names its exact order code | 180 |
| FAMILY | a family document covers it, with a declared reason | 17 |
| OPEN PICK | no part chosen yet, so no datasheet can exist | 15 |
| NOT USED | named in a document only to record that it was rejected | 1 |
| UNCOVERED | no document and no declaration. This must be 0 | 0 |

213 items in all. 70 tokens were dropped by the extractor and every one is listed with its
reason in `out/kb_inventory-excluded.txt`, because a hand-made exclusion list is where a
real part disappears quietly.
